title: Lab - Configure networking and network services
description: Give a host a static address and check what it serves.
scenario: Give a host a static address and check what it serves. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own VM and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# Any Linux VM with sudo will do - Ubuntu 22.04 or Rocky 9, 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM.
# Snapshot it before you start so a broken task is a revert away.
sudo -i
hostnamectl
cleanup: # Revert the VM snapshot, or undo the changes you made by hand.

tasks.title: Task 1 - Static IP
tasks.instructions: Set a static IPv4 address 10.0.0.50/24 with gateway 10.0.0.1 on the primary interface using nmcli (or netplan).
tasks.solution: nmcli con mod eth0 ipv4.addresses 10.0.0.50/24 ipv4.gateway 10.0.0.1 ipv4.method manual && nmcli con up eth0

tasks.title: Task 2 - Hostname
tasks.instructions: Set the hostname to node1.lab.local and make it resolve locally.
tasks.solution:
hostnamectl set-hostname node1.lab.local
echo "10.0.0.50 node1.lab.local node1" >> /etc/hosts

tasks.title: Task 3 - Listeners
tasks.instructions: List every TCP port the host listens on, with the owning process.
